remoteUpgradeUnsupported: This client does not support remote updates. Upgrade it locally first.
updateInProgress: An update is already in progress. Wait for the result.
debugWarning: Use debug mode only for troubleshooting. It continuously writes full logs and may fill the disk over time. Return to the normal startup command when finished.
executorMissing: This Executor no longer exists. A startup command cannot be generated.
configChanged: The configuration has changed. Refresh and try again.
modelUnavailable: This model is no longer available. Select another model.
configIncomplete: The startup configuration is incomplete. Save it before generating a command.
temporaryOverrideUnsupported: Temporary startup overrides are not supported. Save the configuration first.
clientKindMissingError: This Executor has no client type. A startup command cannot be generated.
unconfiguredPreview: Not configured: select and save startup settings before generating a command.
restartRequested: Request sent. Waiting for the client restart result.
commandFailed: Failed to generate the startup command.
copyFailed: Automatic copying failed. Copy it manually.
tokenUnavailableRecreate: The token cannot be displayed. Create a new Executor.
configReadFailed: Failed to read the startup configuration. A command cannot be generated.
configReadSaveFailed: Failed to read the startup configuration. It cannot be saved.
configSaveFailed: Failed to save the startup configuration.
configSaved: Startup configuration saved. Restart the Executor with the new command to apply it.
maintenanceHelp: The client restarts when idle. Running tasks return a busy response and are not interrupted. Update and restart checks the latest release; local source builds can only restart the compiled program.
restartUnsupported: This client has not reported remote restart support. Upgrade it locally to a supported version first.
title: Executor management
autoUpdateHelp: When enabled, the server sends update commands between task assignments when an Executor is behind the target version. Configure this setting in the server application.yml (enabled by default).
noneUpgradable: No Executors in the current selection can be updated.
concurrentHelp: Default: 5. Range: 1–10. Takes effect after restart.
name: Executor name
missingKindHelp: This older Executor has no client type. Select and save a client type before generating a startup command.
notConfiguredHelp: This Executor has no startup settings. Select and save them first.
missingKindExtra: Only older Executors without a client type need this selection. It cannot be changed after saving.
previewIncomplete: Complete valid startup settings to preview the command.
accessEditCommand: Edit the full executor startup command
accessApplyCommand: Apply the executor startup command online
editableCommandHelp: Use macOS / Linux argument and quoting syntax. Edit the exact release version, --workspace-root, --name, --debug, and existing startup options. Connection credentials, executor identity, and the token proxy argument cannot change. Pipes and other shell commands are not supported.
onlineCommandHelp: Online application supports macOS / Linux, with force restart or restart when idle. The current version or a newer stable release is supported. Historical task files stay in their original directory; an unspecified workspace keeps the current directory.
commandSaved: Startup command saved. Apply it online or copy it to start locally.
commandSaveFailed: Failed to save the startup command
commandApplyRequested: Command saved and sent. Waiting for the executor to restart with the new configuration.
commandSavedApplyFailed: Command saved, but online application failed. Check the reason and retry.
commandSavedApplyFailedWithReason: Command saved, but online application failed: {{reason}}
onlineCommandWindowsUnsupported: Online application only supports macOS / Linux. Copy the Windows command and run it locally.
onlineCommandOffline: The executor is offline. Save the command and apply it when the executor is online.
onlineCommandUnsupported: This client does not support applying startup commands online. Upgrade it locally first.
onlineCommandPending: A restart is already in progress. Wait for its result before applying the command.
saveTokenWarning: Copy and save the token now. It cannot be viewed again after closing this dialog.
createdWithoutToken: Executor created. The plaintext token is available to administrators only; ask an administrator to retrieve it and hand it over.
commandAdminOnly: The startup command embeds the executor token and is visible to administrators only.
bulkUpdateHelp: Executors update and restart between task assignments. Executors with running tasks are skipped.
autoUpdateOffHelp: Automatic updates are disabled. Skipped Executors will not retry automatically; handle each one in the results.
upToDate: Already at target version {{version}}. No update is needed.
debugCopied: Debug command copied ({{shell}}). Use it only for troubleshooting. Return to the normal startup command when finished to prevent logs from filling the disk.
bulkWarning_other: Target version {{version}}. {{count}} Executors in the current selection can be updated.
bulkWarning_one: Target version {{version}}. {{count}} Executor in the current selection can be updated.
restartSystemRequested: Request sent. Waiting for the client response.
restartSystemTimedOut: No heartbeat was received after the restart. Check the client.
restartSystemCompleted: The client has restarted and is online.
skipActiveTask: An update is already in progress.
skipUnsupportedClient: The client does not support remote updates.
modelUpgradePolicyHelp: Select a model at your configured entry thresholds when the same task returns to the same Agent. First entries use the default model. New tasks start over. Disabled policies do not upgrade.
modelUpgradePolicyModelPlaceholder: Enter a model ID supported by this executor
modelUpgradePolicyValidation: Configure strictly increasing integer thresholds of at least 2 and distinct model IDs.
modelUpgradePolicySaved: Policy saved. It takes effect at the next handoff launch. No executor restart is needed.
modelUpgradePolicyEffective: Applies at the next handoff launch. No startup command changes or executor restart required.
modelUpgradePolicyUnavailable: A configured model is no longer in the current catalog. Please select another model.
modelUpgradePolicyReadFailed: Failed to load model upgrade policy. Please retry.
modelUpgradePolicySaveFailed: Failed to save model upgrade policy. Please retry.
onlineRestartPolicyUnsupported: This client does not support restart policies. Upgrade the client first.
restartWhenIdleHelp: Restart when idle: stop accepting new work, wait for current tasks and conversations to finish, then restart with the saved settings.
restartForceHelp: Force restart interrupts current tasks and conversations. Tasks will prepare again or resume from the latest available checkpoint using existing recovery data; some work may repeat. Conversations may not resume. The workspace cannot change while work is active.
restartPolicyTimedOut: No client progress or restart heartbeat was received for the online application. Check the client.
